adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered Table 2 MIC rows plus biofilm/FIC/cytotoxicity records from local XML/PDF/database surfaces; worker-4 reconciled DBAASP rows with source locators while preserving figure-derived cytotoxicity cautions; worker-6 closes the prior framework-only rework ticket as accepted_with_cautions.

materials_exhausted.note: PMC/OA package contains no supplementary files; XML tables, PDF text, OA figures, and linked DBAASP rows were checked.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP target-activity, biofilm, FIC, and literature rows were reconciled against primary Table 1/2/3 and text/figure locators; exact cytotoxic percentages remain explicit source_conflict cautions because they are not tabulated in XML/PDF text.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary MIC matrix, Table 3 FIC values, biofilm MBIC rows, and qualitative HaCaT cytotoxicity evidence are recorded with raw values/units/targets/locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Only phenotype-level growth, morphology, biofilm, and combination-assay claims are retained; no direct molecular target is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The prior open rework ticket is closed only when strict semantic and publication gates pass.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP contains exact HaCaT killing percentages, but the primary XML/PDF text provides qualitative no/moderate cytotoxicity and Figure A3 context rather than extractable numeric bars.
The paper supports MIC, biofilm, morphology, and FIC phenotypes; direct membrane or intracellular target mechanisms are background context and not final claims.
DBAASP names such as NCR335 (48-64) are mapped to source Table 1 names such as NCR335C17-33, with the mapping retained in database audit rows.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local primary XML/PDF text states qualitative HaCaT cytotoxicity and references Figure A3; exact database percentages are not present as text/table values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact DBAASP percentages are retained as source_conflict cautions; qualitative toxicity conclusion remains source-supported.
